title: The Grateful Dead Live at William and Mary College Hall on 1973-09-11

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a horn‑enhanced show with a soaring Dark Star, epic Weather Report Suite and a stunning Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard mix that showcases Jerry Garcia’s lyrical guitar tone and the added horns from Keith Hornsby’s band. Musically the concert shines with an inspired first set, a standout Weather Report Suite, a melodic Dark Star and a majestic Morning Dew that builds to a powerful climax.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are strongly positive (average 4.5★) and highlight both superb performance and high‑quality soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix that captures Garcia’s guitar tones beautifully; occasional brief audience source cut during the end jam but overall clean and well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as outstanding and high‑energy; second set features the unique horn‑infused Weather Report Suite, a concise but powerful Dark Star, and a slowly building Morning Dew that culminates in an epic finish. Overall flow is praised for its seamless transitions and experimental jazz‑orchestral flavor.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia delivers melodic, lyrical solos with sweet licks on Morning Dew; his guitar tone is highlighted as superbly captured.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for strong, interactive jams with Jerry throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Hornsby’s piano and vocals are front‑and‑center, especially on “Let Me Sing Your Blues Away” and his contributions to the Weather Report Suite.
